title: Mojo 510 Battery by Red Eye
description:
RExperience effortless vaping with the MOJO by Red Eye, a sleek and powerful 650mAh cartridge battery designed for ultimate convenience. Featuring auto-draw or button activation, 10 adjustable voltage settings, and a 1.8V preheat mode, it delivers a customizable experience for any 510-threaded cartridge. With USB-C fast charging, a magnetic removable bottom, and built-in safety shut-offs, the MOJO is the perfect fusion of performance and portability.

Product Features:
– Capacity: 650mAh
– Fits Most 0.5ML-2ML Carts
– Voltage Range: 2.4 / 2.6 / 2.8 / 3.0 / 3.2 / 3.4 / 3.6 / 3.8 / 4.0 / 4.2V
– Preheating Function: 1.8V Preheat for 15 Seconds
– 10 Second Auto Heat Shut-Off
– 30 Minutes Safety Shut-Off
– Auto Draw or Power Button for Convenience
– USB-C Fast Charging
– Removable Magnetic Bottom
– Cartridges Sold Separately

What’s Included:
1 x MOJO by Red Eye
1 x charging cable

QUICK START INSTRUCTIONS
Device must be charged for 1 hour before the first use
Remove the bottom magnetic end
Insert your 510 threaded cartridge

Auto Draw Function
– 5 x quick puffs to turn the device ON/OFF
– 2 x quick puffs to activate pre-heat mode
– 3 x quick puffs to change the voltage settings.

Power Button Function
– 5 x quick clicks to turn the device ON/OFF
– 2 x quick clicks to activate pre-heat mode
– 3 x quick clicks to change the voltage settings
